summary_text: All 48 primary trials and three 180-second sustained trials completed on the same frozen native binary. Collection was interrupted three times: a minimized high-resolution 5,000-stroke trial at 510 measured callbacks, followed by two screen-fit failures after the user moved windows (271 and zero measured callbacks). Each rejected attempt is retained. Resumption copied only the strictly validated contiguous prefix with checksum provenance; the final suite reused 22 accepted trials and executed the remaining 26. Time gaps and resumed collection are part of these results; no rejected samples enter aggregates.

No actionable finding. Subsequent report changes add memory/startup caveats, chart accessibility and navigation links; native measured code unchanged.

Final native screenshots reviewed. Visible legend, larger mobile labels and keyboard focus fixes re-reviewed and confirmed; no remaining visual/report blocker.
checks.native_final_inspection: Measured binary 462629e launched interactively in a separate 30-frame live trace with 12 warm-up frames. Run starts, completes and restores Run enabled/Stop disabled; preview visible. Not included in performance aggregates.
checks.browser_inspection: Desktop 1280x900 and mobile 390x844 inspected. No horizontal document overflow; chart regions scroll and keyboard ArrowRight operates the focused chart; viewport restored.

interpretation_erratum: Raw quality.cache_policy says fresh full-view raster. The verified behavior is full paint command reissue with retained CGPaths and no application bitmap cache. System caching, completed rasterization and composition remain unobserved. Raw records are preserved unchanged.
scope_limits: CPU callback costs and callback intervals are not completed GPU work or physical pen latency.
Core Graphics uses actual backing-size NSView; historical GPU texture presentation is fitted inside a different preview size.
Whole-process RSS excludes separate WindowServer/compositor process costs and is not physical footprint or GPU memory.
One Mac/display/OS, three fresh processes per cell, sequential fixture ordering and resumed collection; no cross-platform performance claim.
Final lifecycle ledger seal is an observation endpoint, not an OS event-delivery or presentation fence.

raw_archive.distribution: Retained locally, not committed or uploaded. Contains accepted suites, interrupted attempts, pilots, validation checks and final interactive inspection.
